title: Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.13504v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content. Latent diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for restoring missing detail, but their effectiveness is constrained by how HDR signals pass through the pretrained VAE. We find that common log-like encodings suppress low-luminance chromatic differences before generation, producing a dark-side collapse in the frozen-VAE latent. We introduce EquivFlow, a compact, invertible exposure-equivariant encoding that maps exposure changes to additive shifts while retaining a scale-independent chromatic component, without modifying the VAE. Encoding-level tests across pretrained image and video VAEs show that its exposure structure and deep-dark chroma transport persist across the tested hosts. translated_title: 暗物质：面向SDR到HDR视频重建的VAE感知HDR编码
translated_abstract: SDR到HDR重建是一个病态问题，需要在保留原始内容的同时恢复被截断的高光、被压缩的阴影以及量化伪影。潜在扩散模型为恢复缺失细节提供了强大的生成先验，但其有效性受限于HDR信号如何通过预训练的VAE。我们发现常见的类对数编码在生成之前就抑制了低亮度区域的色彩差异，导致冻结VAE潜空间中出现“暗部坍缩”现象。我们提出了EquivFlow，一种紧凑、可逆的曝光等变编码，它将曝光变化映射为加性偏移，同时保留与尺度无关的色彩分量，且无需修改VAE。在多个预训练图像和视频VAE上进行的编码级测试表明，其曝光结构和深暗部色彩传递能力在所测试的各类宿主模型中均能保持。将EquivFlow集成到SDR到HDR视频扩散模型中，可带来（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出EquivFlow，一种紧凑可逆的曝光等变HDR编码，解决了类对数编码在冻结VAE潜空间中导致的暗部色彩坍缩问题，无需修改VAE即可提升SDR到HDR视频重建的暗部细节与色彩恢复能力。
en_tdlr: EquivFlow, a compact invertible exposure-equivariant HDR encoding, prevents dark-side chroma collapse in frozen VAE latents and improves SDR-to-HDR video reconstruction without modifying the VAE.
